newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: The Bombay bullion market was closed on Monday for a Hindu festival. It reopens on Tuesday.
Dealers said they expect gold to firm this week in response to monetory reforms announced during the weekend by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) aimed at providing more funds to banks.
They said silver would look towards world markets for direction after moving downwards in the last few days.
In the week to Saturday, gold rose 25 rupees per 10 grammes to 5,150 rupees but silver lost 100 rupees per kg to 6,950. (Conversion $1=35.67 rupees)
